summary: Associates changes in control authority or mode with their recorded causes and times.
description: Associates changes in control authority or mode with their recorded causes and times. Microgrid supervision coordinates measurements, control authority and resource communication without replacing local protection. Each resource value needs a named measurement boundary, freshness condition and intended control use.

In a microgrid control room, the operator can see source availability, active constraints and current operating mode. A communication failure should remain distinguishable from an electrical resource failure. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Control authority events” at the input and “Mode and authority history” at the output. Event timing quality needs retention.
